text:
Hubo a time in that the valle sonreía,

silencioso, aunque nadie there vivía;

his gente había marchado hacia the guerra

confiando the cuidado of esa sierra,

for the night, a the mirada fiel

of the estrellas desde his azul cuartel

and of day, a the rojos resplandores

of the sol that dormitaba between the flores.

Mas now for all visitante

the valle sad is inquieto e inquietante.

Nada there is detiene a alone instante…

nada salvo the aire that is cierne

over the soledad mágica and perenne.

¡Ah, ningún viento agita the ramajes

that palpitan as the glacial oleaje

in torno a the Hébridas salvajes!

¡Ah, ningún viento empuja the furtivo

manto of nubes that, without respiro,

surcan durante the day the sky esquivo

over the violetas there esparcidas

as eyes humanos of mil medidas…!

over the ondeantes azucenas

that lloran junto a the tumbas ajenas!

Ondean: and in his pétalos more tiernos

is juntan gotas of rocío sempiterno.

Lloran: and for his tallos claudicantes

bajan perennes lágrimas as diamantes.

translation.title: The valle intranquilo
